SELECT DISTINCT
    e."name",
    e."event_space"
FROM "eventspaces" e
WHERE e."capacity" = 200
  AND (
      LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
      OR LOWER(e."event_space") LIKE '%conference%'
  );
3:
SELECT r."name"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
  AND LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%'

UNION


SELECT r."name"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%'
  AND LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%cafe%';
4:
SELECT DISTINCT r."name", r."address", r."food_service", r."cuisine"
FROM "restaurants" r
WHERE LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%'
   OR (LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%cafe%' AND LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%')
ORDER BY r."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
10:
SELECT "r"."name"
FROM "room" AS "r"
WHERE LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%lobby%'
   OR (LOWER("r"."name") LIKE '%terrace%' AND "r"."size" = 500);
12:
SELECT rs."name"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."type" LIKE '%day spa%'

UNION ALL


SELECT rs."name"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."type" LIKE '%wellness retreat%'
  AND rs."price" = 150.0;
13:
SELECT "name"
FROM "relaxation_spot"
WHERE "price" = 150.0
  AND ("type" ILIKE '%day spa%' OR "type" ILIKE '%wellness retreat%');
14:
SELECT DISTINCT
    rs."name",
    rs."type"
FROM "relaxation_spot" rs
WHERE rs."price" = 150.0
  AND (
      LOWER(rs."type") LIKE '%spa%'
      OR LOWER(rs."type") LIKE '%wellness%'
      OR LOWER(rs."type") LIKE '%retreat%'
  )

15:
SELECT DISTINCT
    "es"."name",
    "es"."event_space",
    "es"."capacity"
FROM "eventspaces" AS "es"
WHERE LOWER("es"."event_space") LIKE '%banquet%'
   OR (LOWER("es"."event_space") LIKE '%conference%' AND "es"."capacity" = 200)
ORDER BY "es"."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
24:
SELECT DISTINCT
    c."name",
    c."vacation_option"
FROM "customers" c
WHERE LOWER(c."activities") LIKE '%dance%'
  AND (
      LOWER(c."vacation_option") LIKE '%cruise%'
      OR LOWER(c."vacation_option") LIKE '%resort%'
  )
ORDER BY c."vacation_option" ASC NULLS FIRST, c."name" ASC NULLS FIRST;
25:

FROM "customers" c

41:
SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf."feature" ILIKE '%swimming%'
GROUP BY h."name"

UNION


SELECT h."name" AS hotel_name
FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND lf."feature" ILIKE '%hot tub%'
GROUP BY h."name"

43:

FROM "hotel" h
JOIN "city" c ON c."id" = h."city_id"
JOIN "roomtype" rt ON rt."hotel_id" = h."id"
JOIN "featureinroom" fr ON fr."roomtype_id" = rt."id"
JOIN "leisurefeature" lf ON lf."id" = fr."leisurefeature_id"
WHERE c."name" LIKE '%New York%'
  AND (lf."feature" ILIKE '%pool%' OR lf."feature" ILIKE '%hot tub%')

44:
SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
WHERE LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%guest%'

UNION


SELECT DISTINCT g."fullname"
FROM "guests" g
JOIN "bookings" b ON b."guestid" = g."id"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air%'
  AND LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%'
45:
SELECT DISTINCT
    g."fullname",
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(r."typeofroom") LIKE '%suite%' THEN 'air-conditioned suite'
        ELSE 'air-conditioned guest room'
    END AS "roomcategory"
FROM "bookings" b
JOIN "guests" g ON g."id" = b."guestid"
JOIN "rooms" r ON r."roomid" = b."roomid"
JOIN "services" s ON s."serviceid" = r."serviceid"
WHERE LOWER(s."amenity") LIKE '%air-condition%'
   OR LOWER(s."description") LIKE '%air-condition%'
ORDER BY g."fullname" ASC NULLS FIRST, "roomcategory" ASC NULLS FIRST;

SELECT c."channel_value"
FROM "channels" c
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" crc ON crc."channel_id" = c."channel_id"
GROUP BY c."channel_id", c."channel_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT crc."representative_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "customer_service_representatives"
);
164:
SELECT
    csr."full_name",
    ch."channel_value"
FROM "customer_service_representatives" csr
JOIN "customer_service_representatives_channels" csrc
    ON csrc."representative_id" = csr."id"
JOIN "channels" ch
    ON ch."channel_id" = csrc."channel_id"
ORDER BY csr."full_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, ch."channel_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
168:
SELECT
    cc."company_name",
    br."role_value"
FROM "construction_companies" AS cc
JOIN "construction_companies_building_roles" AS ccbr
    ON ccbr."construction_company_id" = cc."id"
JOIN "building_roles" AS br
    ON br."role_id" = ccbr."building_role_id"
ORDER BY cc."company_name" ASC NULLS FIRST, br."role_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;
171:
SELECT br."role_value"
FROM "building_roles" br
JOIN "construction_companies_building_roles" ccbr
  ON ccbr."building_role_id" = br."role_id"
GROUP BY br."role_id", br."role_value"
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ccbr."construction_company_id") = (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "id") FROM "construction_companies"
)
ORDER BY br."role_value" ASC NULLS FIRST;

173:

312:
SELECT DISTINCT sc."full_name"
FROM "sous_chef" sc
JOIN "restaurant" r ON r."sous_chef_id" = sc."sous_id"
JOIN "orders" o ON o."restaurant_id" = r."restaurant_id"
JOIN "order_details" od ON od."order_id" = o."order_id"
JOIN "menu_items" mi ON mi."menu_item_id" = od."menu_item_id"
WHERE LOWER(mi."item_name") LIKE '%pizza%';
